blocker1PartialSave.fix: submit() now derives per-section 'dirty' state from a snapshot/current-value comparison (generalSnapshotRef + legalSnapshotRef, populated/patched throughout load(), plus 8 pure *GroupDirty comparator functions matching the existing RPC/bundle granularity: legal, contact-bundle [owner/manager only], colors, mapsUrl, identity, bgColor, social, languages). ONLY dirty sections are mutation candidates. Each dirty section is attempted independently (no invented cross-RPC transaction). Outcome reporting is three-way and unambiguous: (a) all dirty sections succeed, or none were dirty -> stSaved; (b) zero of the attempted sections succeed -> their failure message(s) directly, nothing to hide; (c) MIXED (>=1 success, >=1 failure) -> new stPartialSaveError-prefixed message naming the failure(s) explicitly, success indicator never shown.
